samples.stimulus: The table shows the number of riders for several values of the cost of a bike ride. The relationship between the two quantities is linear.
samples.question: Which statement best describes the value of the number of riders at the start, according to the linear relationship?
options: When the cost of a bike ride is 0 dollars, the number of riders is 2 riders.
When the cost of a bike ride is 0 dollars, the number of riders is 10 riders.
When the cost of a bike ride is 0 dollars, the number of riders is 4 riders.
The number of riders increases by 4 riders for each increase of 1 dollar in the cost of a bike ride.
samples.answer: When the cost of a bike ride is 0 dollars, the number of riders is 4 riders.
samples.explanation: (1) 표에서 두 행 (3, 10) 과 (4, 12) 을 읽는다. (2) 기울기 = (12 - 10) ÷ (4 - 3) = 2 이다. (3) x = 0 일 때 값: 10 - (2) × 3 = 4 이다. (4) 표의 첫 행 x 는 3 이라 첫 행 값은 처음 값이 아니다. (5) 절편은 입력이 0 일 때의 값을 뜻한다. 따라서 정답은 C이다.
